name: peek
title: Peek
description: A record over the right of the page area without leaving its list; a bottom sheet with snap points on a phone.

meta.whenToUse: Looking at a record from a list, board, table, search result, Inbox or a mention chip, without leaving it: ↑ ↓ walk the list, ⤢ opens the full page.
meta.whenNotToUse: Working on one record — open its page (RecordLayout); a form or a confirmation — Dialog or Sheet.
